_about: The intake for one complaint. Every value that came from a document carries the reading id that supports it; anything the person typed carries "typed". student.respondent is optional: the respondent as it should print when it is not the district line as read (a Board of Education, a city-wide agency) — a reading id if a document names it, "typed" if the person chose it. Delete this key when you copy the file.

runMeta.model: the model id that ran the skill

district.value: the district as the documents name it

F1.question: What the district did, or failed to do

F2.question: How the Parent learned of it

claims.impact: How the failure impeded the student's education or the parent's participation, one to three sentences, each ending with its tags. [R..][F3]

relief.detail: how much, of what, and when

additionalContents.heading: what the state requires beyond § 300.508(b)
additionalContents.text: the value, exactly as it should print — or ____________ if nothing in the file supplies it
additionalContents.note: optional: why it is blank or what the person should check; reaches the report, never the pleading
